kata.name: Bridge weak lens: divergent abstraction result — the delegation equation finds it, the conventional test finds it too
kata.series_verdict: pre-registered: Bridge has no proven equivalence in ploeh §6; the delegation lens is expected to buy zero unique detections (parity)

expected.detail: the weak lens is the equation impl∘impl_op = op (the abstraction delegates its result to the implementor); the seeded fault makes Abstraction row 1 return r3 while its implementor returns r2. The scripted conventional refinement test compares op to impl_op∘impl for every abstraction, so the detection is parity.

commands: python3 prototype/weak_lens_set_baseline.py --assert  # exit 0: scripted conventional test matches the pre-registered detections
cargo run -q -p catherine-cli -- check fixtures/katas/weak-lens-set/bridge-fault-divergent-op.ct.json --json  # exit 3, 1 findings
cargo test -p catherine-ledger --test weak_lens_set_kata  # frozen evidence test

comparison.conventional_baseline: scripted Bridge test: for every abstraction, op = impl_op(impl); covers both abstraction rows

expressibility_gap.invariant: independent variation of the abstraction and implementation hierarchies
expressibility_gap.why: only the one declared delegation path is checked; the pattern property that both hierarchies vary independently has no path-equation form

discrepancies: ploeh-grounding.md §6 lists these patterns as HYPOTHESIZED candidates, not proven equivalences; this slice records parity or a null result and does not upgrade any of them.
procedure: 1. control first: validate the near-floor control's empty unique set and killed verdict before any positive is read.
2. probe arm: cargo run -q -p catherine-cli -- check <fixture> --json; findings recorded verbatim.
3. baseline arm: python3 prototype/weak_lens_set_baseline.py --assert; detections are the pre-registered element names.
4. unique = probe elements - baseline elements; the element vocabulary is fixed in fixtures/katas/weak-lens-set/README.md.
5. verdict: empty unique with an expressible lens => killed (parity); an unexpressible lens with zero findings => killed with the gap recorded (null result).
